dependency_text: The listings and kinds of the even-orientation study; the cell reading and order count of the cross-pair study; the birth choices of LOCAL-COMMUTE.
objective: Direction 1 of the even-orientation study (the cross-pair study's direction 2, sharpened), taken at a STOP under the owner's standing rule: at every grown closure and census type, list the minimal sets of knots whose whole choice (every unheld pair with all four holders in the set) commutes with nothing selected, as four mutually meeting knots carry the three-reader game; read their signs and kinds. G18 Comparing growth laws, toward G1. Stop when every closure and type has its sets listed (subsets of at most eight knots above twelve), or at the first size that cannot be finished.

title: Whole-choice sets: sets of knots whose own candidate cells commute with nothing selected
